%1 times per day, as an immediate action, you can cause a spellcaster (including yourself) within 30 feet to trigger a primal magic event as the spell is being cast.
You can cause any creature in the act of activating a magic item to trigger a primal magic event. |PREVARGTEQ:OracleLVL,13

A spellcaster can make a concentration check (DC = 15 + twice the spell's level) to focus the magic and avoid triggering a primal magic effect, but non-spellcasters activating magic items have no such option.
